model.target: Estimate the zero-intercept contemporaneous US100 log-return relationship to US500 log-return. It estimates common-market exposure, not a forward return signal.
model.fit: All complete synchronized consecutive H1 return observations in2024 whose availability end is strictly before2025-01-01. Fixed prior beta1 with moment penalty1e-6: Sxy=1e-6+sum(r500*r100); Sxx=1e-6+sum(r500*r500). No fit search or outcome-selected hedge fraction.
model.inference: Fresh float32 ONNX Div/Clip/Mul graph. beta=clip(Sxy/Sxx,0.25,3.0); target hedge lots=0.5*beta*(parent US100 volume*US100 entry price*US100 contract)/(current US500 reference price*US500 contract). Round down to US500 volume step, never round up through minimum. The fixed0.5 hedge fraction is indivisible across both roles.
model.online: Initialize same2024moments. For each newly complete2025+H1 pair, only when label_end<new H1 forecast bar, update Sxy=0.995*Sxy+r500*r100; Sxx=0.995*Sxx+r500*r500. Process chronologically once, no resets. No label from a2024bar excluded by fit is adopted into online initialization. Log prediction/state/update timing and retain raw moments.
model.failure: Nonfinite or nonpositive variance/model inference is an engineering fault; skip the optional hedge and retain original protection. Never enlarge hedge volume to force availability.

hedge_policy.opportunity: After durable accepted original Cross BIRTH, at most one hedge attempt for that parent position id. Require fresh executable US500 quote/session, no own hedge, source-protected parent still present and at least one full parent planned-risk budget of unused original aggregate capacity. If admission fails, leave original parent unchanged and record skipped hedge; no retry after economic admission rejection.
hedge_policy.volume_direction: Opposite the parent direction, graph-sized floor-rounded lots, original symbol min/max. Static/online differ only by moment updates.
hedge_policy.risk: Own identity and seventh component slot; native planned-risk budget no larger than both the parent's original planned risk and current original4%conservative-capital budget. Apply original modeled-risk fraction, tick-aligned protective stop,12%aggregate and45%margin limits with all seven exposures counted. No synthetic hedge netting credit reduces gross planned risk. Model hedge volume can be overridden downward only by rejection, not fitted rescaling.
hedge_policy.exit: Close on parent completion or original four-H1-bar deadline, whichever occurs first, using original durable close/reconciliation. Own SL can close earlier; no re-entry for the same parent and no change to parent management. Persistent parent association prevents orphan reopening; owning EA must close any surviving hedge after parent's reconciled completion before admitting subsequent new hedges. No direct Live use.
hedge_policy.native_integrity: Physical self-contained derived source; all hardcoded six-component risk/state/identity/observation boundaries must cover the seventh slot. Independent hedge Magic/schema/events/parent id and original recovery protections; normal compilation and complete native runs, no test/checker infrastructure.

selection.period: 2025 only; original Cross BIRTH/CLOSE population. All original parent trades retained, including missing quote windows, no-headroom and sub-minimum hedge quantities. Both halves and complete date populations retained.
selection.proxy_entry: First US500 M1 open at or after parent entry second rounded up to the next minute, maximum120seconds. Beta must use only hourly labels available strictly before floor(actual proxy entry hour); use parent actual US100 entry notional and this US500 bid open for ratio. Source aggregate headroom must be>=source parent planned risk. A long proxy uses bid open+that M1 representative spread, short bid open. Representative spread is an execution approximation, not a forecast feature.
selection.proxy_exit_stop: First US500 M1 open at or after parent CLOSE second rounded up, maximum120seconds; follow every intervening observed M1. Standalone protective gross budget=0.5*parent planned risk, stop tick-aligned toward entry with tick0.01, opposite to entry; normal original buffered/clearance concepts retained. Long stop uses M1 bid low; short uses bid high+representative spread. If stop and parent close share a minute, stop takes precedence; gap stop fills at worse of stop and executable open. No favorable intrabar sequencing. Missing expected M1 inside the open window marks the hedge unscored, not a fictitious fill or zero cost.
selection.accounting: Record standalone approximate hedge quote PNL with unit contract and actual rounded proxy volume. Actual proxy spread is paid once; stress deducts one additional roundtrip spread charge (mean entry/exit spread*volume). No positive financing credit. It does not reconstruct a candidate account, permit old-dollar scaling or claim compound/native-DD improvement; actual hedge SL, concurrent admission, fills and equity feedback require native execution.
